description: This file is a Java class implementing data access object (DAO) functionality for 'IntegrationModule' entities, including methods to retrieve module configurations and modules by code using QueryDSL in a Spring repository context.

classes.name: ModuleConfigurationDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of DAO for IntegrationModule entity, providing methods for querying module configurations and module details by code.

methods.name: getModulesConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves a list of IntegrationModule objects matching the specified module name.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a single IntegrationModule object based on the specified module code.
